verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair privacy question for an email API that processes customer message content, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no Resend documentation, policy or setting saying customer data is excluded from AI model training or offering an opt-out. The SSO, API-key permission and suppression-list items cover other features and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
